messages:
mike: Quick note from the q-onboard sweep for marlin-q4: ~6% of contract responses have the array fields embedded as escaped/quoted strings. This trips our strict deserializer and causes retry amplification. Sample below.
sophie: Did this land after the PTQ recipe change or after the KV packing tweak? Any raw token dumps?
mike: It lines up with the q4 PTQ + a small decoder remap. Repro curl: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"marlin-q4","prompt":"produce actions","max_tokens":80}'
```
Bad (truncated):
```
{"id":"r200","output":"{\"actions\": \"[\"create_issue\", \"assign_owner\"]\", \"meta\": {\"score\": 0.95}}"}
```
So actions is a JSON-encoded string. Downstream parse fails and clients are retrying side-effects.
dan: Short-term: no blind retries for endpoints marked side-effecting. Add an SDK rescue path that attempts safe unescape+json.loads only when the payload shape looks right, and emit metric escaped_contracts_count.
sophie: Also add canary lint: fail onboarding if escaped-contracts > 0.5% on the eval slice. We should block marlin-q4 from dedicated contract routes until we have a fix.
ci-bot: Canary job 4465432100-marlin-q4-onboard created. Status: running.
mike: I ran a 2k golden-run vs marlin-fp16: contract pass delta ~5.8% and escaped_contracts at 6.1%. Reproduced both streaming and non-streaming, temps 0.0 and 0.3.
dan: Mitigations plan: 1) deploy conservative SDK rescue behind feature flag; 2) add telemetry sampling for rescued payloads; 3) route contract endpoints to fp16 baseline; 4) attempt micro-head bias fine-tune or small PTQ tweak.
sophie: SDK rescue prototype (very conservative): 
```
def rescue_contract_field(obj, key):
    v = obj.get(key)
    if isinstance(v, str) and (v.startswith('[') or v.startswith('\"[') or v.count('\\\"')>2):
        try:
            candidate = v.encode('utf-8').decode('unicode_escape')
            parsed = json.loads(candidate)
            # verify schema quickly
            if isinstance(parsed, list):
                return parsed
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None
```
Keep opt-in and log full samples.
dan: Add runtime lint to detect leading-quote tokens in contract outputs and optionally prevent rollout. Long-term: instrument token dumps in PTQ pipeline to catch remap patterns.
mike: Filed INC-2217 and linked the canary job. Posting the top failing prompts to the ticket. If anyone sees similar patterns on other models, please add to the incident.
sophie: Good. I'll follow up with the 5k golden-run artifact and a proposed PTQ tweak to avoid the token remap that seems correlated.
ci-bot: Incident created: #INC-2217 linked to 4465432100.
